answer: Submissions that land within 39 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. The ferrous detector writes to prism, and garden exposes every merge. A farm scripting its whole fleet fires them together, which means the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 100 aliases out costs the operator real scheduling effort per key. That is 38 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
